name: Brookside Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 43.8216,-93.0008: campground lanes in woods north of 320th St; a creek runs through the trees west of the loops, not fronted by sites; not waterfront

name: Shooting Star Casino RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 47.3061,-95.9636: paved RV lot beside the casino parking; the Wild Rice River bends ~50 m south behind a tree belt; not waterfront

name: Lum Park RV Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 46.3693,-94.1641: RV loop in Lum Park among trees; Rice Lake shore is ~150 m north past the park buildings; not waterfront

name: Saginaw Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 46.8454,-92.4181: RV loops in a clearing at the US 2 / MN 33 roundabout; no water; not waterfront

name: Hungry Jack Lodge Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 48.0603,-90.4526: campsites in forest north of the lodge buildings, ~150 m back from the Hungry Jack Lake shore; not waterfront

name: Pine Acres Resort & Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 48.0517,-92.8418: a row of RV sites strung along the Orr Bay shoreline with docks off it, matching the operator's '30 lakefront sites with electricity, water, and docking'; lakefront
